FunQuiz.//: ForceSkipWebSockets: when true, the FunQuiz SignalR client skips the WebSocket transport and uses ServerSentEvents / LongPolling. Enable on dev boxes where the WebSocket upgrade is slow (30-60s on this dev box per .memories/repo/pominigames-signalr.md). Production should leave this false.

Inference.//ModelId: Default in-browser model. SmolLM2-360M is the smallest configured option and is chosen deliberately: it is what auto-loads when the host's cloud relay is unavailable, and it is the only size where a first-visit download is defensible on an instant-play platform.

LocalModelOptions.Label: SmolLM2 360M
LocalModelOptions.Description: Smallest footprint — fastest first load, runs on low-end laptops.

LocalModelOptions.Label: Qwen2.5 0.5B
LocalModelOptions.Description: Best tiny multilingual and coding-oriented option for mixed-language prompts.

LocalModelOptions.Label: Llama 3.2 1B
LocalModelOptions.Description: Best reasoning of the three; largest download.

Inference.//RemoteModelOptions: Removed. The cloud option is no longer declared here — the client asked for 'gpt-5.4-nano' while the host's allowlist held gpt-4o-mini/gpt-4o, so the one remote model the UI offered was one the relay would not serve. GET /api/infer/status now reports the deployment that actually backs this game, and the picker builds its Cloud group from that.

Simulation.//MaxInferredAgentsPerTurn: Agents that get a real model call each turn; the rest reuse their last action and read 'Inference deferred'. Was 1, so with TeamSize 3 five of six agents were on the fallback every turn and the log looked like nothing was thinking. 3 is a round-robin majority per turn while staying inside the orchestrator's turn budget. Turns may run longer than SpeedMs while the calls resolve — the _ticking guard makes that self-regulating.
Simulation.//MaxTurns: Stalemate cap. 0 disables it (and restores the old never-ending behaviour).
